Name: FS - SB's Oversized Sleeves
Author: medicsun
Description:
Please report any visual glitches or missing animations.

These are fitted to the vanilla farmer, meaning there may be missing or extra pixels with custom farmer body mods.

I wasn't able to test every animation (panning rng sucks) but the sleeves "roll" up when you harvest/milk, and pan!

Known Problems:
No Slingshot Frames (I will update this mod to current fashion sense, which now supports slingshot frames)

You need at least version 4.11.3 of Fashion Sense

[b]Do you prefer another mod's oversized sleeves? Here's how to convert them to Fashion Sense:
[/b]Do the sleeves have extra transparent space? Make sure to crop it to 197 x 672 pixels (width x height)
Are they grayscale or colored? (e.g. Lambeeron's oversized sleeves are in red)
If they are colored, you need to edit the images to grayscale ([i]make sure to not turn the skin gray as well[/i])
You will need to find the RGB codes of the grayscale image (not hexcode format because Fashion Sense uses RGB values)
Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=files]Fashion Sense's Example Pack under optional files,[/url] find Sleeves > SleevesTemplate > sleeves.json
Open sleeves.json
[spoiler]
 "ColorMasks": [
      [ 36, 36, 36 ],
      [ 119, 119, 119 ],
      [ 158, 158, 158 ]
    ],
[/spoiler]
Change these values to the RGB codes of your grayscale image (you will probably need to do this regardless whether or not you made it grayscale)
(if you have more shades/colors, just copy and paste the existing ones to add more. Don't forget to add or delete commas!!)

[b]You will need to replace ColorMasks for every direction. There are 4 directions in the sleeves.json[/b]
[list]
[*]FrontSleeves
[*]BackSleeves
[*]RightSleeves
[*]LeftSleeves
[/list]
After all that, replace the sleeves image with your edited one
This should work. If it doesn't, feel free to contact me.
